answer_1.quote: We focus on extractive summarization of lengthy documents, including both written documents and transcripts of spoken language... Our goal is to create an extractive summary of the document by selecting a subset of K sentences.
answer_1.outputs: Extracted sentences forming an extractive summary of the source document

answer_2.quote: Standard evaluation metrics (ROUGE; , including R-1, R-2 and R-L, are used to measure the quality of system summaries.

answer_4.quote: We performed evaluation using Amazon Mechanical Turk on 100 randomly selected summarization instances from arXiv... We focus on evaluating informativeness and diversity of summary sentences.
answer_4.guideline: Turkers rated each summary sentence on a relevance scale of 1 to 5 for informativeness and judged diversity by determining whether sentences provided new content compared to common sentences.
